candidates.name: motion-and-uncertainty-v1
candidates.guidance: Use multiple historical ball positions to estimate approach direction. Near a change of direction, do not extrapolate an older velocity through a reflection. Distinguish motion toward the player from motion toward the opponent. Treat a missing ball or an invalid velocity as missing evidence. Account for the requested action duration and the fixed continuation policy, not just the immediate distance to the ball.
outcome_guidance: Look for an approaching ball that cannot be covered by the player paddle under the specified continuation.
No point must occur during the entire horizon; this is not a substitute for uncertainty.
Consider whether the opponent will miss after the ball travels or rebounds toward it.
